questions.text: Which assets, identities, data classes, trust boundaries, and external dependencies are materially in scope?
Which security, privacy, compliance, and operational assumptions are evidenced, unknown, or contradicted?
Which credible misuse, compromise, disclosure, integrity, availability, and recovery paths remain?
Does each material risk map to a preventive, detective, or recovery control with an owner and testable evidence?
Are collection, purpose, minimization, access, retention, deletion, residency, and disclosure obligations evidenced end to end?
Are exceptions, waivers, compensating controls, expiration, and revalidation bound to authoritative records?
Which independent observations prove each material control is present and effective rather than merely declared?
Which residual risks and unavailable evidence require an explicit owner decision outside this pack?
